protocol.cutoff_selection: First newest candidate passing fixed training-only feasibility gates; never compare validation/holdout for cutoff
protocol.gate_qualification: Pragmatic exploratory sample/stability thresholds, not formal power or stationarity guarantees.
protocol.purge: All input, target and rolling dependency source events confined to partition
protocol.target: Magnitude_Value ML, identity; no Mc censoring

mc.method: MAXC modal bin and GFT95 then GFT90; no automatic MAXC substitution for failed GFT
mc.grid: centers at multiples of width; lower-closed upper-open bins, ties to upper bin

protocol.sampler: weights=1+0.5*clip((train_y-4)/1.5,0,1); replacement; n_train draws; sorted parents; numpy SeedSequence([42,epoch])
protocol.selection: Minimum validation MAE; ties favor clean; freeze before one holdout evaluation
protocol.historical_holdout_exposure: New partition within old training catalog; not previously unseen external data. Do not evaluate old model on it or compare old/new scores as proof of improvement.
protocol.analysis_end: 2022-12-31; later target values never inform cutoff or preprocessing decisions

source_eligibility: Original CSV verified against retained ML provenance; unchanged exclusion rules
boundary_handling: Drop targets until all20 inputs and rolling-feature dependency events lie in partition
holdout_history: Previously used by original model during training; retrospective reuse disclosed
